story_structure.value: And–But–Therefore (clarity), declared before drafting in i1's Phase 1 Narrative Gate: AND — the model answers from what is in front of it; BUT — what is in front of it is only right now, yesterday is not on the desk; THEREFORE — forgetting is not a flaw in the model, it is the shape of context itself. Performed as eight lines: the complaint voiced and the wrong explanation killed (L1) → the term named inside its own definition (L2) → the definition's contents counted on screen (L3) → the mechanism as a place, the drawer planted (L4) → forgetting performed as one motion, the slide (L5) → the drawer transformed: your files keep what slid off (L6) → the harness performs the fix, named and glossed (L7) → the definition-only close with its hard edge (L8). Bookend (N-08): L1's 'yesterday' returns in L8's 'right now — and nothing else'; the removal test is structural (without the close the piece ends on a setup tip, not the definition).
